name: LC Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Ampli S.A. is a Polish company primarily involved in the distribution of electrical products, serving both wholesale and retail markets. Their offerings encompass a range of lighting solutions, including diverse light sources, modern induction and LED luminaires, and comprehensive control systems. These products are utilized across various sectors, such as industrial production and warehouse facilities, street lighting, and general building applications. The company was founded in Tarnów, Poland, in 1990, where its main office remains located.
